avoid.tooltipDetail: One of the picks below has too large a gap between the model's probability and the market's implied probability (≥ 30 points). Historically the market is right in this case — spot the pick flagged ⚠ and skip it, the others remain valid.
avoid.edgeTooltip: Model/market divergence: {pct} — this pick triggered the Caution signal

calibration.tooltipDetail: The model and the market strongly disagree on this match (flipped favorite or extreme gap across several bookmakers). This almost always signals corrupted input data, not an opportunity: the match is removed from all our coupons and from the home picks. Predictions stay visible for reading; on these matches, above 1.45, our percentages are clearly too optimistic.

consensus.tooltipDetail: Several independent channels selected the same outcome without coordinating. It is an agreement, not a guarantee: CONSENSUS no longer emits a pick or a probability of its own — the one it used to publish was the maximum across the agreeing channels, and therefore optimistic by construction.

arbitrage.title: AI opinion

arbitrage.description: The AI rereads our readings of the match and both teams' stats, then suggests a bet or abstains. Its percentages come in about as often as announced, but like the rest of the engine it does not beat the bookmaker's odds: a second reading, not a tip.
